# MyChat (نجوى)

> Arabic-first real-time chat web application with WebSocket and REST transport resilience, session-based JWT authentication, and web push notifications.

This application provides an authenticated messaging workspace built with React, TypeScript, and Socket.IO. Private API routes under `/api/` are disallowed for crawlers and require user authentication.

## Application Pages

- [Home Workspace](/): Main chat workspace (redirects unauthenticated visitors to the sign-in page).
- [Sign In](/login): User authentication page.
- [Create Account](/register): New user registration page.
- [Security Settings](/settings/security): Account security, password, profile avatar, and push notification settings.

## Machine-Readable Resources

- [Web App Manifest](/manifest.webmanifest): Progressive Web App metadata, icons, and display settings.
- [AI Resource Catalog](/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) manifest for this domain.
- [Crawler Policy](/robots.txt): Standard crawler access directives.
